case_name: Manandeep Singh Kukreja & Ors v. State Of Nct Of Delhi & Anr

parties.respondent_defendant: State Of Nct Of Delhi & Anr (wife, CAW Cell, Punjabi Bagh, Delhi)

facts_of_case: Marriage between husband and wife was solemnised in 2016. No issue was born from the wedlock. Parties lived separately since 2018 due to disputes. A complaint was filed under Section 12 of DV Act, though now both complaints are withdrawn. Parties entered into a compromise and settled all their disputes vide a MoU dated 14.02.2020.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can settle their disputes through a compromise.
legal_principles.held: The parties have now entered into a compromise and have settled all their disputes
cited_cases: Manandeep Singh Kukreja & Ors vs State Of Nct Of Delhi & Anr, (2020)

legal_principles.principle: Mutual consent is a valid ground for divorce.
legal_principles.held: They have since obtained divorce by mutual consent.
cited_cases: Manandeep Singh Kukreja & Ors vs State Of Nct Of Delhi & Anr, (2020)

outcome.final_order: FIR No.262/2018 under Sections 406/498A/506/34 IPC at police station Punjabi Bagh, Delhi stands disposed of.
